lines.say: Cadbury dropped the Wispa bar in 2003. Four years later, fans still begged.
By August 2007, the Facebook groups had nearly fourteen thousand members.
Think about that. There wasn't one bar for sale, and people still cared enough to organize.
That October it came back, twenty three million bars. Your quiet regulars probably miss you too.
So say it first. Been a minute, chair's open Thursday.
Comment KEEP and we'll show you who's gone quiet.
